```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
tier_order <- c("Power", "Group of 5", "FCS and below")
tier_colors <- tier_palette()
# The last complete season; the 2026 season is still being played.
last_season <- 2025L
played <- tbl(con, "team_season") |>
  filter(games_played > 0, season <= last_season) |>
  collect() |>
  mutate(tier_label = factor(tier_label, levels = tier_order))
# FBS schools, with the Pac-10 rename handled by realignment_moves().
fbs <- filter(played, classification == "fbs")
moves <- realignment_moves(fbs)
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
moves_n <- moves |>
  count(season, name = "moves") |>
  tidyr::complete(season = 2011:last_season, fill = list(moves = 0L)) |>
  mutate(wave = season %in% c(2011:2014, 2023:2024))
peak1 <- moves_n$moves[moves_n$season == 2013L]
peak2 <- moves_n$moves[moves_n$season == 2024L]
p <- ggplot(moves_n, aes(season, moves, fill = wave)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = paste0(season, ": ", moves, " conference changes"),
      data_id = season
    ),
    width = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(`TRUE` = "#374151", `FALSE` = "grey65"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2011, last_season, 2)) +
  labs(
    title = "FBS conference changes by season",
    subtitle = "Schools that changed conference or went independent; the two waves in dark",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Conference changes",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "fbs-realignment-waves", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: table
teams_by_tier <- count(played, season, tier_label, name = "teams")
conf_by_tier <- played |>
  filter(conference != "FBS Independents" | is.na(conference)) |>
  group_by(season, tier_label) |>
  summarise(conferences = n_distinct(conference), .groups = "drop")
sel <- c(2010L, 2012L, 2013L, 2014L, 2023L, 2024L, 2025L)
teams_by_tier |>
  left_join(conf_by_tier, by = c("season", "tier_label")) |>
  filter(season %in% sel) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = tier_label,
    values_from = c(teams, conferences)
  ) |>
  left_join(count(moves, season, name = "moved"), by = "season") |>
  transmute(
    Season = season,
    `Power teams` = teams_Power,
    `Power conferences` = conferences_Power,
    `Group of 5 teams` = `teams_Group of 5`,
    `Group of 5 conferences` = `conferences_Group of 5`,
    `FCS and below teams` = fmt(`teams_FCS and below`),
    `FBS conference changes` = coalesce(moved, 0L)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c(
      "Season", "Power teams", "Power conferences", "Group of 5 teams",
      "Group of 5 conferences", "FCS and below teams", "FBS conference changes"
    ),
    caption = "Teams that played at least one recorded game, and the conferences they played in, by tier, in seasons around the two waves. Conference counts leave out the FBS independents; conference changes include moves into and out of independence. FCS-and-below team counts jump in 2021 and 2022 as more Division II and III games enter the data."
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: movers
movers <- fbs |>
  filter(team %in% moves$team) |>
  left_join(
    summarise(group_by(moves, team), first_move = min(season)),
    by = "team"
  )
p_movers <- ggplot(
  movers,
  aes(season, reorder(team, -first_move), fill = tier_label)
) +
  geom_tile_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = paste0(team, ", ", season, ": ", conference, " (", tier_label, ")"),
      data_id = team
    ),
    color = "white"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = tier_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2010, last_season, 3)) +
  labs(
    x = "Season",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Every FBS school that changed conference",
    subtitle = "Ordered by first move, earliest at the top; hover a tile for the conference",
    caption = "Gaps are seasons a school played outside FBS or played no games."
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl(base_size = 12)
card_interactive(p_movers)
```
